text: ひろい　ところで　Ｂボタンを　おすと　はやく　はしれます！

structure.en: if you press the B Button

structure.jp: はやく　はしれます！

patterns.name: 〜と (if)
patterns.explanation: と after a verb means 'whenever you do this, that follows'. Ｂボタンを　おすと = 'when you press B'.

patterns.name: 〜れる (potential)
patterns.explanation: This form of はしる means 'can run'. はしれます = 'can run'.

patterns.name: 〜で (place)
patterns.explanation: で after a place says where the action happens. ひろい　ところで = 'in a wide place'.
